steps.description: Using the raw integer counts.csv (12000 genes x 12 samples, from Salmon) and metadata.csv (condition, time levels t0/t1, time_hours), pre-filter genes to keep >=10 counts in >=3 samples (the smallest group size). Fit DESeq2 with design ~condition*time, explicit reference levels set for both condition and time factors (state which level is reference). Extract three results via named contrasts/coefficients: (1) the interaction term (condition:time) — the primary answer to the research question; (2) the simple effect of condition at the reference time point; (3) the simple effect of condition at the other time point (main effect + interaction). Apply ashr shrinkage (not apeglm, since these involve multi-coefficient contrasts) to each of the three result sets, keeping both unshrunken and shrunken log2FoldChange plus lfcSE. Apply Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment with independent filtering at alpha=0.05 for each contrast separately, inspecting the p-value histogram before trusting the adjusted values. Flag genes with NA p-values from Cook's-distance outlier detection (small cell sizes, 3 reps, so DESeq2 sets these to NA rather than replacing them). Report count of significant genes (padj<0.05) per contrast, and explicitly state that with n=3 per cell the interaction test has low power (large SE on a difference-of-differences) — absence from the interaction list does not mean the effect is equal across time points.
acceptance_criteria: DESeqDataSet fit with design ~condition*time and explicit reference levels stated
Three result tables produced: interaction, simple effect at reference time, simple effect at other time, each with padj, shrunken and unshrunken log2FoldChange, lfcSE

Power limitation of the interaction test at n=3/cell stated explicitly in output

plan.title: DESeq2 condition x time interaction + enrichment
plan.analytical_narrative: The research question asks whether the treatment effect differs between the two time points (t0 vs t1) in this 2x2 design (condition x time, n=3 per cell, 12000 genes x 12 samples, raw Salmon counts). This is an interaction question. QC first checks sample structure (PCA/heatmap on blinded VST) to confirm no unexpected batch or outlier confounds the 2x2 cells. DESeq2 is fit with design ~condition*time, testing the interaction coefficient (condition:time) as the primary answer to 'does the treatment effect differ by time point', with the simple effects (condition effect at t0, condition effect at t1) reported alongside per DESeq2 interaction-model convention. With only 3 replicates per cell the interaction test is explicitly underpowered (a difference of differences), so the plan reports this power limitation rather than loosening thresholds. LFC shrinkage (ashr, since these are multi-coefficient contrasts) and BH-adjusted multiple testing with independent filtering follow. Enrichment uses over-representation analysis (per the knowledge-service ruling for this situation) on the significant gene lists from each contrast (interaction + two simple effects), against the tested-gene universe, using the human Hallmark, Reactome, and WikiPathways gene sets staged in the reference store. A final report step consolidates DE tables, diagnostics, enrichment, and the power caveats.
